digest.component_or_area: Live Jira Cloud integration lane (external mutation harness)
propositions: JQL search visibility lags behind Cloud Lucene index due to eventual consistency, causing fixed 6x5s retry budget to timeout; replace with env-tunable exponential backoff (base 3s, cap 30s, 10 retries max)

Live Cloud mutation never exercised because only read-only lane exists and is gated off; create bounded, self-cleaning live-mutation test module that drives coordinator lifecycle (create, binding, commit-unknown recovery, fuse) on single throwaway issue
Live-mutation module must always delete created issue (finally block + label sweep) to prevent prod pollution and prove self-cleaning safety model
New CI workflow lane jira-cloud-mutation-probe must run check-access preflight, execute mutation module, and tear down via always-run acli sweep keyed on run-specific label

Config ownership violation (multiple read-via markers on access_check.py) requires JQL backoff parameters move to config.resolve_jql_backoff composition root with lazy import to avoid eager credential-package load
